decisions.reason: As a flagship premium raisin stollen with an externally validated quality signal and very high fit to the firm's existing confectionery know-how, it is highly likely to be retained.

The dark barley malt rye bread remains close enough to the bakery's established bread-making capabilities for management to keep and refine it, though its somewhat niche position leaves a moderate rationalisation risk.
Marzipan Christmas stollen builds directly on the firm's seasonal stollen competence and complements the successful flagship line, so it is more likely to be kept than removed.
